profile.headline: Experienced Javascript Frontend Engineer Leader | Certified Project Management
profile.summary:
I am an experienced Lead Software Engineer with over nineteen (19+) years of web development experience and solid expertise in JavaScript (ES6), Typescript, Vue, React, and Node.js, as well as backend technologies such as Java and Spring.

My strong project management skills, which have been instrumental in leading several large-scale and complex projects, are backed by a certification from New York University. Additionally, my certification in user experience design from MIT CSAIL has enhanced my ability to create user-centric applications.

I enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams, mentoring junior developers, and solving challenging problems. My focus is always on delivering high-quality products that meet our client's needs and expectations and significantly enhance the user experience. I achieve this using cutting-edge technologies and best practices.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering
positions.description:
Assigned as a contractor to the Capital One Software division, where I primarily contributed to the development of a new Web Components library utilized by multiple single-page applications (SPAs) built with React.js. 

- Created several web component modules using the Lit library, utilizing open-wc for testing, Playwright for automated testing, and Storybook for documentation.

- Participated in code reviews by providing constructive feedback and establishing coding practices that enhanced consistency in development, ultimately making the code easier to maintain.

- Provided technical support to the SPAs by assisting with component integration and resolving reported issues.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · LIT · TypeScript · Systems Design

positions.title: Director, UI Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated with VPs, product managers, and user experience (UX) teams to gather application requirements and produce functional specifications and action plans for the engineering team.

- Managed the development team using agile methodologies in JIRA, creating sprint tasks, and defining annual development plans to align with the company's medium and long-term goals.

- Owned the product development of new functionalities for the application, designing intuitive user interfaces and creating wireframes for developers using design tools like Sketch, and sharing in Zeplin.

- Conducted code reviews in GIT (source control management) and participated in architectural sessions to establish code standards and optimize application performance.

- Managed and developed the software architecture for various complex projects using different web frameworks, like VueJS, Vuex, JavaScript, TypeScript, ReactJS, Redux, and HTML5, CSS3, creating unit tests with Jest and Puppeteer, and documenting the components using vue-styleguist.

- Designed and built custom end-to-end solutions for customers using JavaScript, Spring MVC, PostgreSQL, Python, and AWS.

positions.title: Manager, UI Engineer
positions.locationName: Greater New York City Area · On-site
positions.description:
Consolidated and expanded a front-end engineering team, overseeing the interviewing, hiring, and mentoring, defining processes to build a cohesive and skilled team.

- Oversaw all stages of the frontend software development process, from conceptualization to launch, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality outcomes.

- Coordinated development activities between the UI engineers and the API and QA teams across global regions.

- Designed and developed modules for the front-end application using Webpack, MarionetteJS, SASS, Bootstrap 3.0, and jQuery, creating unit tests using KarmaJS, Mocha, and Chai and integrating with RESTful microservices services using AJAX.

positions.title: UI Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Greater New York City Area · On-site
positions.description:
Worked in a startup environment company, applying problem-solving skills to provide solutions to requirements using different programming languages, quickly adapting to requirements changes, and converting prototypes to real solutions in a short time.

- Architected and developed a highly configurable front-end application using MarionetteJS (BackboneJS) and additional libraries such as Bootstrap, RequireJS, jQuery, and Gulp.

- Supported legacy applications based on Java, developing different components using D3, JSP, and Struts 2.0. Provided production support, problem resolution according to specified SLAs, and performance optimizations for the app to provide a better user experience (UX).

positions.title: Project Leader
positions.description:
Worked and led diverse engineering teams across multiple General Electric business areas, including GE Transportation, GE Capital, and GE Corporate, implementing diverse web technologies.

- Led the migration of a CMS application from Java JSPs to Backbone JS, integrating with Java web services for enhanced performance and user experience.

- Coordinated development activities for a UI team of 8 developers in Mexico, collaborating with development teams in India and the United States to ensure seamless integration and project success.

- Documented requirements and technical implementations for various application modules, ensuring clear communication and alignment across all teams.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Backbone.js · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · jQuery UI · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Software Project Management · Java

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led development for a web application designed for tablet devices using Sencha Touch 2.0.

- Developed Spring web services for the RestAPI project to support the UI requirements.

- Served as the primary point of contact in the US, receiving client requirements and coordinating efforts with development teams in Mexico and the US.

- Provided production support for the application, ensuring smooth operation and timely issue resolution.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Served as the module Leader for the API of a content management application used by all GE employees around the world. (Cloud).

- Coordinate the development efforts between the development team in Mexico, US and India.

- Developed different services for the application, using Java, and Struts 2.0, gathering requirements and assessing feasibility to satisfy application users needs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed different modules and functionalities for the application, using J2EE, Java Sockets, Struts 2.0 and Spring MVC.
- Developed a new module in the application to mass upload files using Java FX.
- Provided support to different modules in the application used for mass upload and mass download files.

positions.title: Java Consultant
positions.description:
Provided Java consultant services for a government project.

- Developed different modules for the application, using Spring MVC, JSP, Struts 1.0 and Sybase.
- Made architectural refactoring for the application, integrating Spring MVC instead of Java Servlets, to reduce the boiler plate code, and improve the development speed.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Started in an interim program for Java Developers in Mexico City, and joined different projects for financial institutions including Citi Banamex, and Banorte.
- Java Developer working for Grupo Financiero Banorte, performing performance test over the application.
- Java Developer for Citibank Banamex responsible for developing different modules for a Customer Service application based on Struts 1.0 and consuming an EJB provided by File Net.
- Coordinated the engineering efforts to deliver the application to production, troubleshooting any reported problems and ensuring proper communication between customers and the engineering team.

Technologies and Frameworks: J2SE 1.5, Struts 1.0, Sybase, JSP, FileNet.
Development Tools: Eclipse, Struts, Sybase, JavaScript, Web logic 9.2.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Java Enterprise Edition · Java · Struts

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
As an administrative assistant for McDonald's Mexico, I was primarily responsible for tracking and reporting the financial information for the restaurants to headquarters. 

Some of the additional responsibilities for this position included:

- Create the sales reports required by the store manager and headquarters to track the profit/losses of the restaurant.
- Track and manage the bank deposits of the restaurant and ensure they are according to the reported sales.
- Track and control the restaurant's cash flow, ensuring it will suit the restaurant's demands.
- Administer the restaurant's minor expenses, verify and submit the invoices, and track expenses that were not justified.
- Capture the daily timesheets and hand off the payroll checks to employees.

One of my main achievements was creating a report in Excel for the control and projection of work hours per employee in the restaurant that helped identify potential budget deviations and help adjust the employees schedule for the month.
